# A USD in CAD price stating the guid of the transaction in
# a_transaction_with_its_guid.txt.
#
# GnuCash keeps a guid unique across every kind of object in a book, and a
# price is one of them.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing; the price is refused, and the refusal
# says a transaction holds that guid.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_price_and_another_object_never_share_a_guid.py.
price
	guid: "8a8b8c8d8e8f40418243844586878889"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-01-15 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "1.3642"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"
